title: Derived tensor with coefficient complexes on the small algebraic-space model
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], with its structure-module category [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors] and section universe [def-weil-size-convention]. Use the existing equivalent small ringed model, $D(\mathcal O_X)=X.\mathrm{DerivedModules}$ and its localization $Q$ [def-sfb-space-derived-module-calculus], a specialization of the unbounded localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For a cochain complex $G$ in the original module category, restrict it termwise along the specified small-model module restriction. On the small model form the total tensor functor $T_G:K\mapsto K\otimes G|_{\mathrm{small}}$, using the existing sheafification of the sectionwise tensor and differential $d\otimes1+(-1)^p1\otimes d$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Its sectionwise maps preserve identity, composition and zero maps in each variable; curry these tensor objects and maps at the actual coefficient universe. The composite $T_GQ$ has a total left derived functor at quasi-isomorphisms, by K-flat resolutions. Define $E\otimes^{\mathbf L}G$ for $E\in X.\mathrm{DerivedModules}$ as its value on $E$. This is the categorical left-derived universal property of the specified total tensor, equivalently its K-flat computation, with no supplied arbitrary tensor or representative. The ambient derived category, quasi-coherent cohomology predicate and canonical derived direct image are exactly those already owned by [def-sfb-space-derived-module-calculus].
